parse_train_options: parse training options including learning rate, display frequency, and checkpoint settings for the omnimatte model
configure_learning_rate: configure the initial learning rate and decay policy for adam optimizer during training
set_display_parameters: set visdom display frequency, server, port, and environment for training result visualization
configure_checkpoint_saving: configure checkpoint save frequency and epoch-based saving for model training results
initialize_training_parser: initialize an argparse parser with all training-specific arguments extending base options
